description: This horizontal bar chart, titled “Criterion” on the vertical axis, illustrates the number of participants who evaluated each criterion in a study related to a generative-AI-driven claim retrieval system. The horizontal axis is labeled “Number of Participants” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each bar corresponds to a specific criterion listed vertically: “Relevant FCs,” “FC Summary,” “Relevance Explanation,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation.” The bars are colored in varying shades of purple, blue, and green, with the darkest purple at the top and the lightest green at the bottom. The bar for “Relevant FCs” is the longest, extending to a value of 5, followed by “FC Summary” and “Relevance Explanation,” both at 3. The “Clarity and Simplicity” bar is at 2, while “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation” are all at 1. The bars are sorted in descending order by their length, with the longest bar at the top and the shortest at the bottom. There is no visual emphasis or annotation on any specific bar beyond the numerical value labels at the end of each bar.
